terms.comment: An ancient rope noun; a generic noun, also usable for a climbing rope.

terms.gloss: a rope, a cord (lighter than a fūnis)
evidence: Plaut. Pers. 815: Restim tū tibi cape crassam ac suspende tē.
terms.comment: Accusative usually restim. The rope of comedy is the one a desperate man hangs himself with: ad restim rēs rediit (Ter. Ph. 686), it has come to the rope.

phrases.english: Here are the rope and knot.

phrases.latin: Restim tū tibi cape crassam ac suspende tē.
phrases.english: Get yourself a good thick rope and hang yourself.

sources: Lewis & Short: funis · Lewis & Short: restis
Lewis & Short: funis
